namespace = dod_mid

# Generated by tools/port_missing.py from the Vic2 DoD files the content audit found missing.

dod_mid.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = dod_mid.1.t
	desc = dod_mid.1.d
	flavor = dod_mid.1.f
	event_image = { video = "ep1_cossacks" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = { c:NOV ?= this c:MUS ?= this c:RUS ?= this }
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_mid_sibir }
		NOT = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_TOBOLSK }
	}

	option = {
		name = dod_mid.1.a
		default_option = yes
		set_variable = dod_mid_sibir
		s:STATE_TOBOLSK = { add_claim = root }
		s:STATE_TOMSK = { add_claim = root }
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}

dod_mid.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	title = dod_mid.2.t
	desc = dod_mid.2.d
	flavor = dod_mid.2.f
	event_image = { video = "africa_soldiers_breaking_protest" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		OR = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_LEBANON owns_entire_state_region = STATE_SYRIA }
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_mid_druze }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = dod_mid_druze
	}

	option = {
		name = dod_mid.2.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = { name = dod_mid_druze_crackdown months = 36 }
		every_scope_state = { limit = { OR = { state_region = s:STATE_LEBANON state_region = s:STATE_SYRIA } } add_radicals = { value = medium_radicals } }
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}
